meta.title: Reflexive verbs
meta.subtitle: zich, me and je: zich vervelen, zich herinneren, zich haasten and more
meta.footer: Language Learning · A2 · Verbs · Reflexive verbs

blocks.title: After this PDF you can
bullets: conjugate reflexive verbs with me, je, zich, ons
use the most common reflexive verbs, where English has none
put the reflexive pronoun in the right place
use them in the perfect: Ik heb me verslapen

blocks.text: A reflexive verb has a pronoun that refers back to the subject: Ik was me (I wash myself). Many Dutch verbs are always reflexive, even where English has no -self at all: Ik verveel me = I'm bored.

blocks.title: u: zich or u
blocks.text: With u you can say zich or u: Herinnert u zich dat? / Herinnert u u dat? The first is more common. And in a question with jij you get je je: Verveel je je? That looks odd, but it is correct.

blocks.title: Where English has no -self
bullets: Ik verveel me = I'm bored. (Ik ben verveeld is not Dutch.)
Ik voel me goed = I feel good. Ik vergis me = I'm wrong.
Ik herinner me = I remember. Ik maak me zorgen = I'm worried.

blocks.text: The reflexive pronoun comes right after the conjugated verb, or after the subject if the subject follows the verb. In a subordinate clause it comes right after the subject. A separable prefix still goes to the end.
Reflexive verbs always take hebben in the perfect: Ik heb me verslapen. Ze heeft zich vergist. We hebben ons goed vermaakt (We had a great time).

blocks.title: zich or zichzelf?
blocks.text: zichzelf (myself, himself...) gives emphasis or contrast: Hij praat tegen zichzelf (He's talking to himself). With the fixed reflexive verbs above, use the short form: Hij verveelt zich, not zichzelf.

rows: Subordinate clause: the verb at the end.

blocks.text: Fill in the reflexive pronoun or the verb. The answers are on the last page.

items.q: Ze maakt zich ______ over haar zoon.
items.full: Ze maakt zich zorgen over haar zoon.

items.q: Sorry, ik ______ me. Het is dinsdag.
items.full: Sorry, ik vergis me. Het is dinsdag.

items.q: Mag ik me even ______? Ik ben Tom.
items.full: Mag ik me even voorstellen? Ik ben Tom.

items.q: De kinderen ______ zich in de auto.
items.full: De kinderen vervelen zich in de auto.

items.q: Ik vraag ______ af of hij komt.
items.full: Ik vraag me af of hij komt.
